name: Dynemic Products Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, Dynemic Products is in the business of manufacturing and selling of Dyes & Dye Intermediates[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
DPL is an ISO 9001, ISO 14001, FSSC 22000 & GMP Certified manufacturer and exporter of food colours, offering complete range of Food Colours, Lake Colours, Blended Colours, FD&C Colours & Dye Intermediates

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 2.70% over last 3 years.
